fn test_dur2reltims() {
    assert_eq!(dur2reltims(reltim2dur(0)).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![]);
    assert_eq!(dur2reltims(reltim2dur(42)).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![42]);
    assert_eq!(

        dur2reltims(reltim2dur(abi::TMAX_RELTIM as u64 + 10000)).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        vec![abi::TMAX_RELTIM, 10000]

}
